records.name: Philadelphia Voices of Pride
records.summary: A choir for LGBTQ people and allies in Philadelphia, with close to 150 singers who rehearse on Tuesday nights and perform together.
records.what_you_do: Sing in a mixed-voice choir: rehearse for months before each show, then perform in it.

schedule.text: Rehearsals on Tuesday nights. Auditions are held twice a year, in summer (August) and winter (January).

cost.text: Not listed on the pages checked

first_step.how: Contact the membership team by email to book an audition for the next window
first_step.basis: Joining needs a short audition held only twice a year, so the way in is clear but has fixed dates

records.notes: The join page still lists the August 11, 2026 audition, which has passed. The next audition is expected in January 2027 but is not confirmed. The page gives no rehearsal start time. The 6abc article is dated June 15, 2026 and says joining requires an audition.

records.name: Singing City Choir of Philadelphia
records.summary: A Philadelphia choir that gives a concert series each season and runs a youth program alongside its adult choir.
records.what_you_do: Sing in the adult choir on Tuesday evenings, learn the season's concert music, and perform in the concerts.

schedule.text: Adult choir rehearses Tuesday evenings, 7:20 to 9:50 pm, September through May, with occasional all-day Saturday rehearsals before big concerts.

cost.text: Not stated on the pages checked

first_step.how: Fill in the Audition Request Form on the site. Auditions are by invitation, so the choir decides who is invited
first_step.basis: A request form comes first and auditions are by invitation only, so there is no walk in path

records.notes: The auditions page names the 2026 to 2027 season (tenor and bass auditions open) but gives no month, so no last_sign_of_life month is set. The youth program starts in September at Temple Music Prep, and the year is not shown. The home page lists 1501 Cherry St as the contact address and the auditions page places rehearsals at Friends Center at that address.

records.name: The Philadelphia Chorus
records.summary: A chorus in University City that sings sacred and secular music from many periods. It marks its 75th anniversary with a concert on December 5, 2026.
records.what_you_do: Book an audition by phone, then rehearse on Monday evenings and sing in the chorus concerts.

schedule.text: Rehearses Monday evenings in University City.

cost.text: Not stated on the pages checked

first_step.how: Call 215-995-3118 to book an audition. Auditions are held by appointment
first_step.basis: Listed as an auditioned choir, with audition appointments made by phone

records.notes: The 2026 date is a scheduled concert (Saturday, December 5, 2026, 4 pm, Philadelphia Episcopal Cathedral, 19 S. 38th Street), not a post date. The rehearsal day and audition details come from a directory listing with no date. The chorus site's audition page could not be read.

records.name: Philadelphia Freedom Band
records.summary: An LGBTQ+ community band with several ensembles, including concert and marching bands. It welcomes anyone who wants to play and shares its mission.
records.what_you_do: Play in one of the band's ensembles and take part in its concerts and Pride performances.

schedule.text: Rehearsal days and times are not on the band's site. The band is listed as a co-presenter of pep band and color guard performances at the May 2026 Pride Bands Alliance conference.

cost.text: Dues and fees not stated on the pages checked

first_step.how: Use the contact link on the band's website to ask how to join
first_step.basis: The band says anyone who wants to play and shares its mission can take part, and it lists a contact route. No audition or dues are described on the pages checked

records.notes: The newest dated post on the band's listing is September 27, 2024. The Pride Bands Alliance page was last updated August 8, 2025 and describes May 2026 performances. Whether the band is rehearsing now is not confirmed. The contact email on the site is hidden by an obfuscation tool, so it was not recorded. The Free Library event page for the band returned HTTP 403.

records.name: Philadelphia Folksong Society
records.summary: A nonprofit that runs the Philadelphia Folk Festival each August, a Folk School in Roxborough, and concert series. The festival includes song circles, jam sessions, and open mic time.
records.what_you_do: Attend the festival and its song circles and jams, come to a concert, or volunteer with the society.

schedule.text: The festival runs one weekend each August at Old Pool Farm. Concerts and the Folk School keep their own calendars.

locations.label: Festival site at Old Pool Farm, Upper Salford Township
Folk School and offices in Roxborough

cost.text: Festival tickets cost money. Children under 5 enter free with an adult.

first_step.how: Buy a festival or concert ticket, or volunteer through the society's site
first_step.basis: The festival and concerts are open to anyone with a ticket, but the pages checked do not describe a beginner program

records.notes: The newest dated post on pfs.org is August 27, 2026, announcing a preview show and board meeting on September 23, 2026 at the Arden Theatre in Old City. The 2026 festival was scheduled for August 14 to 16, 2026 at Old Pool Farm, outside the city. Not confirmed: whether the Folk School runs regular classes now. The Roxborough location and the mini-festival formats come from the Wikipedia page.

records.name: Settlement Music School
records.summary: A music school with several Philadelphia branches. Adults can take individual lessons, group classes, and ensembles, including jazz, piano, and rock.
records.what_you_do: Take a group class or join an ensemble with other adults, or book individual lessons at a branch.

schedule.text: Adult classes and ensembles run through the year. The adult page does not list days or times.

locations.label: Several branches, including Germantown, Wynnefield and Kardon Northeast

cost.text: Tuition is charged. The site has a Financial Aid link, but the adult page does not list amounts.

first_step.how: Call 215-320-2601 or use the site's contact page to ask about adult classes and financial aid
first_step.basis: The site says it welcomes all ages and skill levels, from beginners to established musicians, and lists a phone line

records.notes: The adult page has no dated news item, so no last_sign_of_life is set. The branch list includes Willow Grove, which is outside the city. The page gives only a PO box mailing address and no branch street addresses. The adult page does not explain how financial aid works. A separate Older Adult Daytime Program has its own tuition page.

records.name: Play On Philly
records.summary: A free music program for Philadelphia students. Kids borrow an orchestral instrument and get lessons and time in ensembles.
records.what_you_do: Students take instrument lessons and play in ensembles for about 8 hours a week.

schedule.text: Instruction and ensemble practice add up to 8 hours each week, as the program describes it. Days and times are not on the pages checked.

locations.label: Music Center at St. Francis de Sales School

cost.text: Tuition-free, and the instrument loan is free

first_step.how: Start from the program's join page, which links to a family portal
first_step.basis: A sign up path is listed, but the pages checked do not say how students are chosen or whether seats are limited

records.notes: The home page shows no dated news. The program states its age range two ways (PreK to 12 and K to 12), so no age range is set. The Bryn Mawr page calls St. Francis de Sales School the flagship and says there are four Philadelphia locations in all. The contact page was not opened.

records.name: Project HOME Music Production Class
records.summary: A free three-week class for adults at Project HOME's learning center in North Philadelphia. Students learn Logic Pro, a professional music recording program.
records.what_you_do: Attend afternoon sessions Monday to Thursday for about three weeks and learn to record and build music in the software.

schedule.text: Three weeks, Monday to Thursday, 12:30 to 2:30 pm. The November 2026 session runs November 30 to December 17, 2026.

locations.label: Honickman Learning Center Comcast Technology Labs

first_step.how: Apply through the online form linked from the program page, or text MAP to (484) 229-3482. Deadline is Wednesday, November 18, 2026
first_step.basis: Open to adults of any age, but it asks for an application before the class starts

records.notes: The URL slug says July 2026, but the page content describes the November 30 to December 17, 2026 session, so the link may have been reused. No posting date is shown, so last_sign_of_life is the session start month. Logic Pro is the only software named. The listing does not mention DJing, hip hop or songwriting, so do not list those as taught. The listing is run by Project HOME's adult education department and says adults of all ages; it describes no other eligibility rule.

leads_only.name: Greater Philadelphia Chorale
leads_only.note: Adult community chorus listed at St. Jerome Church Hall, 8100 Colfax St. Its own site, gpchorale.com, did not resolve. The listing was added in 2013 and gives conflicting audition terms. Needs a current source before a record.

leads_only.name: Philadelphia Gay Men's Chorus
leads_only.note: Own site loads and lists phone 215-731-9230. The newest dated post is December 13, 2024. Rehearsal days and audition timing are not on the page. A 2017 article said auditions were in August and December. Needs a current audition source before a record.

leads_only.name: Anna Crusis Women's Choir
leads_only.note: A City Cast interview describes this as a long-running feminist women's choir. No website or audition details were found.

leads_only.name: Bucks County Women's Chorus
leads_only.note: Non-audition women's chorus that rehearses in Holland, Bucks County, and draws members from Northeast Philadelphia. The newest article found is from July 2023. Outside the city, so decide whether it counts.

leads_only.name: Philadelphia Boys Choir and Chorale (men's chorale)
leads_only.note: A men's chorale that a 2022 article says is open to adult men with some choral experience. Not checked on the group's own site.

leads_only.name: Temple University Night Owls Campus/Community Band
leads_only.note: A no-audition band open to players of all ages from the region, per a 2013 article. Confirm it still runs through Temple's Boyer College of Music.

leads_only.name: Clef Club of Jazz and Performing Arts Monday night jam
leads_only.note: Monday night jam listed 7 to 11 pm at Broad and Fitzwater. The source article is dated September 26, 2016. Needs a current source.

leads_only.name: 23rd Street jam at Manayunk Brewing Company
leads_only.note: Tuesday jam listed 7:30 to 11 pm, from a 2016 article. Venue-based. Needs a check with the venue.

leads_only.name: Midtown Jazz Jam at Time restaurant
leads_only.note: Sunday jam listed 8 pm to midnight on Sansom Street, from a 2016 article. A restaurant venue, so it may be a recurring event rather than a group.

leads_only.name: Monday jams at World Cafe Live
leads_only.note: Listed 5:30 to 7 pm in a 2016 article. Not verified.

leads_only.name: Rob Henderson jams at Alma Mater (Mt. Airy) and LaRose (Germantown)
leads_only.note: Sunday 6 to 10 pm and Wednesday 7 to 10 pm, from a 2016 article. Not verified.

leads_only.name: Mt. Airy Art Garage jazz jam
leads_only.note: Jazz jam session at Mt. Airy Art Garage. Article date not seen.

leads_only.name: Plough and the Stars Irish music sessions
leads_only.note: Pub sessions on Sunday nights, about 5 to 9 pm, at 123 Chestnut St in Old City, per an undated Temple News article. A business venue, so the owner should decide whether it counts as a community program.

leads_only.name: Philadelphia Ceili Group
leads_only.note: Ran an annual Irish music and dance festival for years, per an archive record. Current status unknown.

leads_only.name: A-Space shape-note singing
leads_only.note: Regular shape-note singing at the A-Space community center on Baltimore Avenue, per an undated article seen only in search results. Check with the venue.

leads_only.name: Keystone Sacred Harp Convention
leads_only.note: Annual January singing convention that brings many singers to Philadelphia, per an undated WHYY page. Not verified.

leads_only.name: Philly Drum Project open drum night
leads_only.note: Free collective with a monthly open-drum night on the first Monday. The evidence is from about 2012 to 2013, so it is probably dormant. Needs a current source.

leads_only.name: Kulu Mele African Dance and Drum Ensemble
leads_only.note: Ensemble founded in 1969 that offers community dance and drum workshops. A February 2026 Afro-Cuban dance class was listed on a Mural Arts page that now returns 404. No official site or current adult drum class was found. Needs its own site before a record.

leads_only.name: Mister Boom Boom and Play Patrol African drum circles at Free Library branches
leads_only.note: Drum circles listed in library calendars, mostly for children. No adult session seen.

leads_only.name: Free Library of Philadelphia Musical Instrument Collection and free beginner lessons
leads_only.note: A search summary says instruments can be borrowed at Parkway Central Library and beginner lessons are offered. The library site returned HTTP 403, so this is unverified.

leads_only.name: Lonnie Young Recreation Center Music Studio
leads_only.note: A search summary describes a free drumming, beat-making and songwriting program for youth and adults. No page was checked.

leads_only.name: Beyond the Bars free music program
leads_only.note: Free music program for youth, date not seen. Probably belongs with the kids research.

leads_only.name: West Chester Area Community Chorus
leads_only.note: All-volunteer chorus in Chester County that holds no auditions. Outside the city. Not checked for Philadelphia residents.

notes: Searches: all 10 used, the hard cap, so the run stopped at budget. Fetches: about 24. Records: 8 publish, 0 hide, 0 other verdicts. Leads: 23. That is below the 20 to 40 target. Gaps: no current adult drum circle, DJ or hip hop group was confirmed; no current Clef Club or other open jam was confirmed (the jam listings are from a 2016 article); no Irish or old-time session was confirmed as a group. The three groups already found (Orchestra Society of Philadelphia, Penn Staff and Community Choir, Encore Chorale) were not re-checked. Mummers were left to the other agent. The PMEA community bands PDF (pmea.net) could not be read by the fetch tool, so these suburban and Philadelphia band names were not verified: Main Line Symphony Orchestra, Germantown Symphony Orchestra, Lansdowne Symphony Orchestra, Merion Concert Band, Jenkintown Community Band, Verdi Band of Norristown, Cardinal Dougherty Alumni Band and Philadelphia Penn View Brass Band. Individual drum teachers and performers were not recorded because they are people, not groups. Pub, bar and restaurant sessions are leads only; the owner should decide if they count. The Project HOME record and the Settlement record both involve paid or sign-up steps that are stated as published.
